assets.title: Jellylight Grotto
assets.prompt: Asset type: complete widescreen 16:9 background painting for Bubble Pop Arena, a polished colourful casual mobile bubble popping game. A magical underwater Jellylight Grotto: softly glowing turquoise water, indigo grotto arches and pearlescent pink jellyfish at the far edges, bioluminescent mushrooms and delicate sea plants framing a sandy bottom. Saturated cyan, violet and warm pink, beautiful painterly game illustration with soft volumetric rays, gentle depth and premium detail. Composition: large calm uncluttered central water area occupying at least 65 percent of image for gameplay, important scenery also survives a central portrait crop; decorative details mainly edges. Full bleed to every edge, no border, no UI, no writing, no watermark, no large circular bubbles or foreground objects that could be mistaken for pop targets. Landscape 1536x864.
